subject: Bug, or me getting the grammar wrong?

messages.author: b19f231547b6c85d
messages.subject: Bug, or me getting the grammar wrong?
parts:
test <- data.frame(x = rep(1:10, 3), y = rnorm(30), a = gl(3, 10) )

# is this a bug or is it just me getting the grammar wrong?
# an unwanted vertical line appears in the legend
ggplot(test, aes(x, y, colour = a)) + geom_line() +
geom_vline(xintercept = 2)

# using I() gives what I want: no vertical lines in the legend
ggplot(test, aes(x, y, colour = a)) + geom_line() +
geom_vline(xintercept = 2, colour = I("black"))

Thanks

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Bug, or me getting the grammar wrong?
parts:
Hi,

The global mapping that you defined, aes(x, y, colour = a), is applied
by default to all the geoms that follow unless you override it. An
alternative to your second version could be,
test <- data.frame(x = rep(1:10, 3), y = rnorm(30), a = gl(3, 10) )

ggplot(test, aes(x, y)) + geom_line(aes(colour = a)) +
geom_vline(xintercept = 2)


HTH,

baptiste
